// Package full declares one C name of every kind the translation covers.
package full

/*
#include "fakeboard.h"
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

typedef uint32_t fake_word;

#define FAKE_INT 0x10000000
#define FAKE_NAME "fakeboard"
#define FAKE_SHIFT(n) ((n) << 4)
#define FAKE_EXPR (FAKE_SHIFT(2) | FAKE_HEADER_VALUE)

struct fake_point { int x; int y; struct fake_point *next; };

enum fake_mode { FAKE_OFF, FAKE_ON = 5, FAKE_AUTO };

extern volatile uint32_t fake_counter;

void fake_copy(const uint8_t *src, uint8_t *dst, size_t n);
*/
import "C"

import _ "syscall" // TinyGo's generated cgo file imports it; machine reaches it the same way

const (
	Int  = C.FAKE_INT
	Name = C.FAKE_NAME
	Expr = C.FAKE_EXPR
	Auto = C.FAKE_AUTO
)

func Copy(src, dst []byte) {
	C.fake_copy((*C.uint8_t)(&src[0]), (*C.uint8_t)(&dst[0]), C.size_t(len(src)))
}

func Word() C.fake_word { return C.fake_word(C.FAKE_INT) }

func Point() C.struct_fake_point { return C.struct_fake_point{x: 1} }

func Mode() C.enum_fake_mode { return C.FAKE_ON }

func Counter() uint32 { return uint32(C.fake_counter) }

// Run calls back into the program that hands it cb.
func Run(cb func(int)) {
	helper()
	cb(1)
}

func helper() {}
